title: Choosing among SAR images for the Gran Sasso scan

tellings.quote: I had to to to to let's say order um different images in order to choose the best one.

plain: For a scan of Gran Sasso, a mountain in Italy, a researcher had to order several satellite radar images and pick the best one. The radar is SAR, synthetic aperture radar, which builds pictures from radar echoes bounced off the ground from space. Filippo Biondi, an engineer who works with this radar, describes doing it himself, saying he had to "order um different images in order to choose the best one," as part of explaining how his method for seeing under the ground works.
